description: This file contains functions and templates for generating challenge markdown content for a coding platform, including various challenge types such as legacy, quiz, video, assignment, multiple choice, fill-in-the-blank, dialogue, and generic challenges.

methods.name: sanitizeTitle
methods.description: Sanitizes the challenge title by adding quotes if it contains ':' or '''.

methods.name: buildFrontMatter
methods.description: Builds the front matter section for a challenge markdown, including id, title, challenge type, and optional language and input type.

methods.name: buildFrontMatterWithVideo
methods.description: Builds front matter with a placeholder for video ID.

methods.name: getLegacyChallengeTemplate
methods.description: Generates a markdown template for legacy challenges with description, instructions, hints, seed, and solutions sections.

methods.name: getQuizChallengeTemplate
methods.description: Generates a quiz challenge markdown with questions, distractors, and answers.

methods.name: getVideoChallengeTemplate
methods.description: Generates a video challenge markdown with description, question, answers, and video solution.

methods.name: getAssignmentChallengeTemplate
methods.description: Generates an assignment challenge markdown with description, assignment, question, answers, and video solution.

methods.name: getMultipleChoiceChallengeTemplate
methods.description: Generates a multiple choice challenge markdown with randomized correct answer and feedback.

methods.name: getDialogueChallengeTemplate
methods.description: Generates a dialogue challenge markdown with scene setup.

methods.name: getDailyJavascriptChallengeTemplate
methods.description: Generates a daily JavaScript challenge markdown with hints, seed, and solutions.

methods.name: getDailyPythonChallengeTemplate
methods.description: Generates a daily Python challenge markdown with hints, seed, and solutions.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Returns the appropriate challenge template function based on challenge type.
